question:

Benchmark knowledge evidence: in the 2015-2016 season refers to season = '2015/2016'; league with most games refers to League.name where MAX(COUNT(id))

prediction.sql:
SELECT L.XCL_005
FROM League AS L
JOIN Match AS M ON L.XCL_003 = M.XCL_008
WHERE M.XCL_009 = '2015/2016'
GROUP BY L.XCL_003, L.XCL_005
ORDER BY COUNT(M.XCL_006) DESC
LIMIT 4;
